argument: Structural audit: all eight @sec-* tokens in the chapter resolve to labels that exist somewhere in the book (six unique ids; zero dangling), the file holds exactly one {=typst} fence, all seven tables carry outlined false, both callouts use the named body form, and both labels sit on the line after their headings. The 23-discipline / 9-category taxonomy and the 9-class starting-Discipline table match ch05, ch21 and ch22. So the chapter is structurally sound, but it is not publishable as written. Blocking: 08:133 defines a card's tier as its Discipline-prereq count and lists skill among the cards, which contradicts 08:15, 08:113 and 08:214, where skills are exempt from all Discipline prerequisites (ch07:17 agrees). Minimal fix: drop skill from the 08:133 parenthetical. Incomplete: 08:210 limits equipment entry requirements to weapons, yet armor and shields also carry Armor / Protection rank requirements (ch16:84-90, ch22:344-364), and ch16:84 sends the reader to this chapter for those full rules, which ch08 never states; also 08:107 announces a magic-item Discipline grant with no link to @sec-chapter-magic-items. Cross-book: ch02:161 says a starting hero holds four to six Disciplines, but 08:73 plus the class table cap the three grant sources at five.

evidence.claim: Regex diff of the chapter's eight @sec tokens (six unique ids) against every label defined across the book returns zero dangling references.
Typst conventions hold: one raw-typst fence, seven of seven tables with outlined false, two of two callouts in named body form, and each label on the line after its heading.
Line 133 asserts that a card's Discipline-prerequisite count defines its tier, and it names skill alongside spell and ability.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Every card (spell, ability, skill) follows a three-tier ladder

evidence.claim: Lines 113 and 15 remove skills from Discipline prerequisites entirely, so the 133 claim is contradicted by the chapter itself.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: they have no Discipline prerequisites at all

evidence.claim: The skills chapter confirms skills never gate access, reserving Discipline gating for weapons, spells and abilities.
Line 210 restricts the entry-requirement rule to weapons and points only to the equipment chapter.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Weapons may list their own Discipline combos as entry requirements

evidence.claim: The armor chapter assigns shields a Protection-rank requirement and directs readers to ch08 for the full rules, which ch08 does not contain.
The quick reference lists a Protection Req for shields and a Disc Req for armor, so those equipment requirements exist book-wide but are absent from ch08.
Line 107 states that magic items may grant a temporary Discipline rank, yet the chapter never cross-references the magic items chapter.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Magic items may grant temporary Disciplines

evidence.claim: The creation chapter claims a starting hero typically holds four to six Disciplines, but the chapter under review caps its three grant sources at five.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: typically has 4-6 Disciplines before spending a single DP
